Section variables at Cotangent.lean:133-134 give `[CommRing B] [Algebra R B]`, so the new equivalence applies verbatim; `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Dual/BaseChange.lean` imports only Mathlib, so no import cycle.

findings.fix: Add `IsBaseChange.toDualBaseChange` / `IsBaseChange.dual` to the `## References` block (lines 30-33), stating that this declaration is the same map with `Module.Free` relaxed to `Module.Projective`.
findings.issue: `baseChangeEvaluationEquiv` restates an equivalence Mathlib already has for finite free modules — `IsBaseChange.toDualBaseChange` specialized to `TensorProduct.isBaseChange R M A` has literally the type `A ⊗[R] Dual R M ≃ₗ[A] Dual A (A ⊗[R] M)` and the same pure-tensor value. It is not redundant (it relaxes `Module.Free` to `Module.Projective`, which the finite locally free application needs), but the file records no relation, leaving two unconnected names for the same map on free modules.

summary: The bialgebra-level base change is new material with no Mathlib or TauCeti equivalent, and the finite-projective dual equivalence correctly reuses `dualTensorHomEquiv`/`liftBaseChangeEquiv`. However, the new general equivalence duplicates a pre-existing private construction in `Tangent/Cotangent.lean`, which should now be routed through it.
